items.title: Share these readings with your care team
items.text: You had 62.7% of your readings in the 70-180 range, which is not quite the target of more than 70%. Your average reading was 178.3 mg/dL, so be sure to discuss this at your next visit.

items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: You didn't walk after any of your scored meals, so you haven't seen the effect yet. Walking after dinner is linked to a rise about 18.3 mg/dL smaller in sugar, with the best results from 10 to 19 minutes of walking.

items.title: Keep meal times steady around your shifts
items.text: Since you work nights, traditional rules about late dinners don't apply to you. Try to keep your main meal at the same point in your waking day, regardless of the clock.
